title: Document that paper capital operations skip owner approval and separation of duties
summary: Documented in services/governance/contract.md (§ Current Approval Policy Scope) that paper capital operations skip owner approval and separation of duties under the 2026-10-06 operator decision and 2026-10-08 operator instruction, citing code locations and historical commits.

capital_guard_early_return.code_fact: is_paper_operation returns early after checking _require_risk_policy when pool.risk_policy_ref is set, bypassing _require_safe_mode and _require_approval

capital_main_paper_allocation_checks.code_fact: evaluate_allocation_policy in paper mode requires the caller to hold the operator role, requires the paper environment (lineage.paper_environment_allowed), and requires promotion_review_id to be non-empty; none of these three checks is an owner approval or a distinct-actor check

bff_paper_checks_removal.code_fact: Deleted paper_simulation_authority and PAPER_SIMULATION_APPROVAL_APPLY_NOT_DISTINCT checks; classified CommandType.APPROVED_APPLY under owner_verifies_approval, delegating approval verification to Capital owner

operator_decision.policy: Approval policy stays as is; document its contractual scope; do not enforce two-man or self-approval rules on paper operations
